name: @veriport/mcp
description: MCP server (stdio) for the Veriport API: validate_vat (EU VAT number on VIES with provenance), validate_iban (five checks, SEPA flag), vat_rate (dated, sourced EU VAT rates), validate_einvoice (XRechnung, Peppol BIS, Factur-X / ZUGFeRD against the official schema and schematron). No dependency, Node 18+.
